minimal_owner_recommendation.owner: Existing encode; keep controls source decode/readiness and the prototype source-prefix/body validation owners. No new function/type/flag/parser or new string-to-glyph map is warranted.
finite_plain_guard: Source-context terminated narrative source only, valid decoded shape/boundary/END and existing authoring policy; literal/positional modes unchanged.
EN has no literal {{ anywhere. Retain default malformed/raw/unsupported markup validation. Do not strip braces or retry as plain after mixed failure.

All HL words that would be omitted by current mixed policy occur strictly before ContentStart; body contains no HL/icon/opaque/scale/true-pen/setup beyond already allowed narrative tokens. Existing source-prefix setup/non-scale pen behavior remains separately bounded.
No leading icon, param8 payload or e800..efff scale/highlight-like family is absorbed into this colour rule.

The only permissible readiness exception is locally proved plain-prefix eligibility (typically current no_markup_yet). Do not treat that readiness value alone as success, mutate source.Readiness, filter caller tokens, change controls diagnostics or call encode recursively with fake context.
minimal_owner_recommendation.copy_semantics: Copy leading HL in EXACT ordinal among setup/HDR/speaker/non-scale state; EN speaker override replaces existing speaker at its ordinal or appends if absent. Prefix is excluded from body wrapping and paired-HL validation; validate prefix with existing source decoder and generated body with existing strict grammar. Structural final PAGE preserved even after EN //. Do not globally relax literal/patch validators.
minimal_owner_recommendation.marked_branch: If EN contains {{, preserve existing full ordered marker/readiness handling and byte outputs. Leading colours are NOT copied a second time; valid markers can reposition them. No silent count/value/kind/order normalization.
minimal_owner_recommendation.policy_honesty: EN absence of braces does not prove translator intent universally: explicit original mixed call with unmarked EN refuses the same source that plain accepts. Root may deliberately adopt this finite union convention, with evidence. If original caller explicitly chooses mixed, retain that choice; do not auto-reclassify all no_markup_yet registry diagnostics.
minimal_owner_recommendation.range: Original source decoder recognizes HL b001..b7ff, while existing authored HL markup only accepts b001..b009. The pack freezes b00a/b7ff plain originals but does not decide to expand authored marker values. Source-copy range choice must be explicit; actual native examples useb007.

why_existing_alternatives_do_not_need_ne.auditStreams_or_plan: They should select canonical wording/context/budget, not duplicate prefix filters/marker math. The same encoder behavior must serve both actual consumers.
why_existing_alternatives_do_not_need_ne.separate_policy_API: Not required to support the finite no-curly+prefix-only branch, but if a consumer requires explicit mixed selection with no markers, absence of braces cannot override that consumer. This study does not add schema or production decisions.
